label: Glamour Wardrobe
description: Evening and event wear — cut, fabric and drape for elegant portraits.

items.name: silk-column-gown
items.text: a bias-cut silk charmeuse column gown, cowl neckline, low draped back, hem pooling at the floor

items.name: sequin-cocktail
items.text: a fitted cocktail dress in graduated paillette sequins, scooped back, every facet throwing light

items.name: velvet-off-shoulder
items.text: an off-shoulder crushed-velvet evening gown, boned bodice, deep wine tones swallowing light into the pile

items.name: tulle-ballgown
items.text: a layered tulle ballgown, structured sweetheart bodice, horsehair-braid hems holding the skirt's cloud shape

items.name: backless-satin
items.text: a backless duchess-satin gown, draped cowl back plunging to the waist, skirt cut on the bias to skim the hips

items.name: tailored-tuxedo-f
items.text: a sharply tailored black tuxedo worn over bare skin, satin peak lapels, cropped trousers and stiletto heels

items.name: beaded-flapper
items.text: a drop-waist flapper dress of beaded fringe rows, glass beads swinging with every step

items.name: high-slit-crepe
items.text: a high-slit crepe evening dress, one sculpted padded shoulder, the leg line revealed to the hip with each stride

items.name: corseted-opera
items.text: a corseted opera gown, steel-boned bodice over structured hip panels, opera-length satin gloves

items.name: metallic-lame
items.text: a liquid metallic lamé slip dress, halter neck, fabric flowing like poured mercury over every curve

items.name: mermaid-gown
items.text: a mermaid-cut gown fitted through hip and thigh, flaring into a trumpet train of stacked organza ruffles

items.name: crystal-illusion
items.text: a sheer illusion gown of crystal-embellished tulle over a nude liner, embroidery placed to trace the figure

items.name: little-black-dress
items.text: a sleeveless little black dress in matte crepe, bateau neckline, princess seams shaping the waist, hem just above the knee, elbow-length gloves

items.name: grecian-goddess
items.text: a one-shoulder Grecian goddess gown, finely pleated chiffon falling from a jeweled shoulder brooch, gold cord crossed under the bust

items.name: feather-hem-gown
items.text: a slim bias-cut satin gown finished in an ostrich-feather hem, plumes stirring around the ankles with every step

items.name: cape-gown
items.text: a fitted column gown with a sheer chiffon cape falling from the shoulder seams, the cape lifting and trailing in motion
